verdict.rationale: Docs consistently describe input as textual "state" (e.g., quickstart: "Paste any text as the state"), context limits given in tokens, and no endpoint or SDK reference anywhere mentions image, audio, or document input/modalities — this is a de facto text-only scoping. However, there is no single explicit "text-only" disclaimer statement; the scoping must be inferred from consistent absence rather than an honest, direct statement. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement scoping Jev to text-only input, and any evidence (positive or negative) about multimodal support being tested or requested.
